title: Continuous Weekly Economic-State Discovery Protocol
objective: Increase independent A-share opportunity frequency by improving event generation density, not by weakening underwriting or promotion thresholds.

coreChange.newPattern: weekly_generic_state_scan -> clustered economic_state_changes -> company mapping -> unchanged underwriting

eventFormationRule: A candidate event may be formed from one high-authority step-change or from two or more independent weaker state changes that point to the same causal mechanism.
A macro state change alone is context unless it can be decomposed into a narrower profit-pool transfer, bottleneck, order pool, cost shift, or company exception.
Do not require a headline, sell-side report, or named theme before creating an event cluster.
Repeated confirmation of the same mechanism is continuation unless magnitude, duration, incidence, or beneficiary set changes materially.

triage.purpose: Spend deep-research budget on economically distinct changes without using later stock returns.
triage.hardRule: Triage may prioritize research order but cannot itself create a stock selection.

acceptance.principle: Prefer a higher opportunity count only when discovery recall rises without a material collapse in quality.
acceptance.holdoutRequirement: Freeze this protocol before testing on a new historical year; do not tune primitives from that year's revealed outcomes.
